text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Mihono Bourbon—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master. Could you spare some time for me
on our next day off?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No.
I will explain the details on the day of the event.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, Master.
Good night."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon headed straight back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Was it just my imagination,
or did they seem to flash a small smile as they left?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the promised day off arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Two minutes before the scheduled time.
The train will be arriving momentarily."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You'll have to wait until we arrive to find out, Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both her actions and her words somehow carry
an air different from the usual Mihono Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could this also be connected to
a 'precious memory'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't tell just yet,
but it certainly didn't seem like a bad thing.
I decided to follow quietly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: We have arrived, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. When I was little, I went training near a ranch with my parents.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...On the way back, we had a meal at the ranch.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to spend some time together with you today, Master,
which is why I invited you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. First, let's look around the farm.
And after that, eat some ice cream and have a meal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Ranch map recorded.
All building and facility locations have been fully accounted for.
Please leave the guiding to me."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us set our objectives and act promptly—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...No. Let's walk slowly.
I deem there is no need to rush.
choice_data_list: Let's just take it easy and have fun.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by the nostalgic scent of grass,
we leisurely toured the ranch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing her ice cream and lunch,
Mihono Bourbon slowly began to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A "precious memory" with Master
was indeed present within me as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: “However, based on past experience, the nuance required to understand the criteria for what is 'precious' has not yet developed……”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So, um...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
“...In other words, it's not that she didn't know,
but rather that she simply hadn't realized it yet.”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you work so hard... acting for my sake,
Master, I finally came to realize it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To me, that "ordinary everyday life"
was precisely what it was.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "...When I found my dream as a child, both my father and mother supported me with everything they had."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Training with her father without missing a single day,
all while her mother always watches over them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't have much recollection of playing childish games, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However, I believe the time I spent with my parents
was actually greater than that of the other children around me."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: And to me, that was something truly irreplaceable...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It was truly a wonderful, happy time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it is daily training,
or simply the time spent
eating a meal with my family."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To me... all of it
was a "precious memory."
choice_data_list: It was a wonderful time, wasn't it.
It was a wonderful time, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yes...
That is correct, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Which is why...
When you asked about my "precious memories with my Trainer,"
I couldn't answer right away...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I judge this to be the expected outcome.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Because every single moment spent with Master...
was truly 'precious' to me."
choice_data_list: So, even at this very moment?
We're in this together, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Because every single moment spent with Master...
was truly 'precious' to me."
choice_data_list: So, even at this very moment?
We're in this together, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I judge that to be the case
at this very moment as well."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it would be problematic
if things like this continue in the future."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, my memory might become
completely full of Master."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Urgent action is required.
Master, please provide a solution.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon spoke in her usual tone,
but a faint smile played at the corners of her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Really...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Training with Master holds the same warmth
I felt in the past.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is why even this... will surely become
a 'precious memory.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However... just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It feels somewhat different from back then...
I can feel how "precious" it is.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Happy...?
choice_data_list: Thank you for cherishing the time we spend together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, as for me...
The time I spend training with you, Master...
and, well, this very moment right now...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's very... precious to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I do not understand the meaning of your thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon quietly muttered, looking away in a rare display of hesitation.
